'''''The Thrawn Trilogy'' Boxed Set''' is a compilation box-set featuring the three novels in ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]'' by [[Timothy Zahn]], published by [[Del Rey]] on [[May 31]], [[2022]] as part of ''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]''<ref name="Penguin" />
